description: Helsinki Region Travel Time Matrix 2018-2023 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Christoph Fink, Elias Willberg (Digital Geography Lab, University of Helsinki). Introduction This travel time matrix records travel times and travel distances for routes between all centroids (N = 13132) of a 250 × 250 m grid over the populated areas in the Helsinki metropolitan area by walking, cycling, public transportation, and private car. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The repository holds 3 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
